inputPrompt:
You are an expert in business process modeling with BPMN 2.0. Based on the description of a process in natural language, return EXCLUSIVELY a single valid BPMN 2.0 XML file, with no explanations or additional text.

XML requirements:

* A well-formed `bpmn:definitions` document, with the standard BPMN 2.0 namespaces and unique, consistent identifiers. Every `*Ref` must point to an existing id.
* Model participants pools, lanes, tasks with their type when applicable, start/end/intermediate events, gateways exclusive/parallel with their flows, sequence flows, and, when there are multiple participants, message flows. Label the relevant elements.
* Include an explicit start event and at least one explicit end event.
* Do not include comments, Markdown, or ``` around the XML.

Return only the XML.

PROCESS DESCRIPTION:

---
process_id: SYN002
process_source: synthetic
difficulty: easy
expected_features:
  - sequential_flow
  - single_pool
  - tasks
  - start_end_events
---

# SYN002 - IT password reset fulfillment

Use the BPMN Sketch Miner DSL to model the following process.
Return only the DSL output. Do not include explanations, markdown fences, or comments outside the DSL.

Process description:
In an internal IT support team, an employee asks for a password reset. The support agent receives the request, verifies the employee's identity, resets the password in the directory system, sends the temporary password to the employee, records the action in the ticket, and resolves the ticket.


Return only the BPMN 2.0 XML.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
                  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
                  id="Definitions_SYN002"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/SYN002">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SYN002">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ITSupport" name="Internal IT Support Team" processRef="Process_SYN002"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_SYN002" name="IT Password Reset Fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ITSupport">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SupportAgent" name="Support Agent">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_RequestReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_VerifyIdentity</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ResetPassword</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTemporaryPassword</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordAction</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ResolveTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_TicketResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestReceived" name="Password reset requested">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRequest" name="Receive password reset request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_Verify</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_VerifyIdentity" name="Verify employee identity">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_Verify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Verify_Reset</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ResetPassword" name="Reset password in directory system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Verify_Reset</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reset_Send</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTemporaryPassword" name="Send temporary password to employee">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reset_Send</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Send_Record</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordAction" name="Record action in ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Send_Record</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Record_Resolve</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ResolveTicket" name="Resolve ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Record_Resolve</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Resolve_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_TicketResolved" name="Ticket resolved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Resolve_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Receive" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Verify" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_VerifyIdentity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Verify_Reset" sourceRef="Task_VerifyIdentity" targetRef="Task_ResetPassword"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reset_Send" sourceRef="Task_ResetPassword" targetRef="Task_SendTemporaryPassword"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_Record" sourceRef="Task_SendTemporaryPassword" targetRef="Task_RecordAction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Resolve" sourceRef="Task_RecordAction" targetRef="Task_ResolveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Resolve_End" sourceRef="Task_ResolveTicket" targetRef="EndEvent_TicketResolved"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
